item.title: Are you running the 2026 London Marathon?
item.description: Are you a Millwall supporter? Are you running the 2026 TCS London Marathon? item.title: Victory for Under 18s over Colchester
item.description: Millwall's Under 18s were 3-1 winners over Colchester United in the Professional Development League on Saturday. The early exchanges saw both teams go close to opening the scoring, but in the 25th minute, a Trialist gave The Lions the lead as he fired home from just inside the penalty area. It took until 10 minutes into the second-half for more goals to come as the Trialist doubled his and Millwall's tally, before Ayman Sheikh made it 3-0 in the 65th minute. item.title: Slender defeat for Millwall Lionesses
item.description: Millwall Lionesses were beaten 1-0 by Dartford on Sunday afternoon. A goal for the hosts in the 68th minute saw Ted Jones' side slip to a first loss in five matches. Madison Grandys made a second Lionesses debut shortly after the goal after re-joining the club earlier last week. item.title: Record 'New' Den League attendance broken for second time in 2025/26
item.description: Millwall Football Club's record League attendance at The 'new' Den' was broken for a second time in a matter of weeks last Saturday. With the record standing at 19,004 following the win over Charlton Athletic on 24th January, a total of 19,153 supporters packed into SE16 as The Lions took on Portsmouth this past weekend, raising the bar by a further 149 fans.
